provenance: RETROSPECTIVE FORMALISATION -- authored 2026-09-06, after this review's screening had already occurred. It records the criteria the review's object states it applied; it is NOT a pre-registration and claims no prospectiveness. The object itself already says its criteria are 'DERIVED POST HOC and say so', so this protocol formalises an admittedly post-hoc screen, it does not manufacture an a-priori one.
grounded_in: screening.eligibility (verbatim), read 2026-09-06. Every eligibility criterion below is READ from that field, not inferred, except design, whose provenance is marked DERIVED in its own criterion text.

population.criterion: Adults with essential or primary hypertension, read from the coded conditions field. Where that field names a study objective rather than a disease (NCT01309828 declares conditions:['Safety']) the limb is NOT_ASSESSABLE and the verdict falls back to the registered trial title, stating on its face which it rests on.

intervention.criterion: Azilsartan medoxomil TOGETHER WITH chlorthalidone in the same arm. Azilsartan monotherapy is a different intervention, and azilsartan with amlodipine is another; neither qualifies.

design.criterion: Randomised controlled trial, parallel-group. DERIVED, not read: the object's eligibility text does not name a design; this is inferred from the review being a pooled comparison of two trials that share both randomised arms. Marked derived so it is not mistaken for a stated criterion.
design.provenance: DERIVED from review structure -- NOT stated in the object

outcomes_reporting.note: Outcomes are a REPORTING field, not an eligibility field. The object states this itself: the estimand 'governs POOLABILITY and not eligibility'. A trial meeting P/I/C/D that does not report this estimand is eligible-and-unreported, never ineligible.

outcomes.name: Change from baseline in clinic systolic blood pressure
outcomes.verbatim_from_object: change from baseline in clinic systolic blood pressure, detected structurally at every rank
